Steamed Rainbow - D.S. & Durga
Steam, Ozone, Green, and Bright
This one is very unique! Opens bright and watery with fresh, crisp, green grass. Ultra calming and refreshing. As it dries down, it settles into more of a mild clean fabric scent. Someone below mentioned it smells like a Dillard's showroom, and I fully agree. It's uncanny how much the dry down reminds me of that. Pleasant smell nonetheless.

Performance wise, it wears very light. It's not a projector. It's more of a personal scent bubble type fragrance. I get about 4 hours out of it, which is passable for a weekend lunch/errand run type of scent. Price wise, FAR too expensive for the performance, but a great smelling fragrance nevertheless.

L'orpheline - Serge Lutens
Incense Fougere
Many people seem to get dark/goth/sad vibes from this. I get none of that. Quite the opposite actually. L'orpheline smells calm, uplifting, and slightly nostalgic to me -- a fougere-like scent. It's smoother, more modern, and airier than a classic fougere though. Incredibly expansive when first sprayed... fills a room almost instantly. Projection from skin is moderate. Longevity is quite good at around 6-8 hours.

Unisex classification is accurate to me. This would work equally well for men and women. Great fragrance!

Naxos - Xerjoff
What am I missing here?
This is one of the most overrated fragrances I've tried. I don't find the combination of honey and tobacco appealing at all, and there is a prominent screechy sweetness in the background. There are some discernable notes in Naxos, but most of it is smothered by noticeably synthetic aromachemicals.

It does perform well, however, in the case of Naxos, that's not a good thing as I wanted to scrub it off immediately.

This is a hard pass for me. Try before you buy.

Acqua di Giò pour Homme Eau de Toilette - Giorgio Armani
Massively overrated
This may have been great in its day, but there are simply better options out there now. I have tried, and tried again to like Acqua Di GIo, but every time I apply it I am let down by its awful performance and flat, forgettable scent. I like the concept of Acqua Di Gio -- and even the initial blast is pleasant -- but I am lucky to get an hour with it before it becomes nearly indetectable.

Overall, it's fine, but not worth a full bottle for me.

Versace Man Eau Fraîche Eau de Toilette - Versace
The carefree fragrance
Bright, clean, watery, uplifting, and very vacation-y. Would not recommend this one for work as it's just too happy and relaxed. Perfect for special occasions or vacations.

While ubiquitous, Man Eau Fraiche maintains a distinct identity within the saturated fresh-aquatic genre. The price point is just right, and it's a real mood lifter.

Performance wise, projection is mild-moderate, and longevity is around 4-5 hours.

Everyone should have this in their collection!
